mapper.select: select work_version from project_work_version where project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into project_work_version(project_id,work_version) values (#{projectId},#{version}) as desired on duplicate key update work_version=desired.work_version
mapper.select: select old_document_id,new_document_id,status,work_version,created_by,created_at,activated_by,activated_at,reason from rfq_document_replacement where project_id=#{projectId} order by created_at,new_document_id
select count(*) from rfq_document_replacement where project_id=#{projectId} and ((old_document_id=#{documentId} and status='active') or (new_document_id=#{documentId} and status='cancelled'))
mapper.update: update rfq_document_replacement set status='cancelled',reason=#{reason} where project_id=#{projectId} and new_document_id=#{newDocumentId} and status='pending'
